title: Ordinary section square for flat-term quotient pull transport
statement: For normalized endpoint ScalarSectionData there is an ordinary section pullback comparison e satisfying the displayed coefficient, scalar-model and pullback square on every module.

proof.text: Whisker the inverse ordinary comparison at Y by section pullback, the inverse section pullComparison for Λ′ by internal scalar extension, the inverse internal CondensedRing.pullIso by the target section equivalence, the ordinary comparison at X by internal pullback, and the section pullComparison for Λ by cX.model.E. Insert associators to obtain an isomorphism after precomposition by the section equivalence at Y.

Precomposition by an equivalence is fully faithful. Take the preimage isomorphism using Functor.preimageIso. Functor.map_preimage evaluated at M identifies its component with the conjugated composite. Expanding the composite and cancelling the adjacent inverse ordinary and pullComparison components proves the displayed square. No generator equation or endpoint normalization hypothesis is needed for this existential square.

lean.statement: theorem section_pull_transport_kflat_ordinary {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y) (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY) : ∃ e : cY.model.E ⋙ pullback Λ' f ≅ pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E, ∀ M : Modules Λ Y, (equivalence Λ' X).functor.map ((CondensedRing.pullIso a f).inv.app M) ≫ cX.ordinary.hom.app ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).obj M) ≫ cX.model.E.map ((pullComparison Λ f).hom.app M) = (pullComparison Λ' f).hom.app ((QuotientChange.extension a Y).obj M) ≫ (pullback Λ' f).map (cY.ordinary.hom.app M) ≫ e.hom.app ((equivalence Λ Y).functor.obj M)
